verification.method: Ordinary public PDF retrieval in GitHub Actions, selected page rendering and visual inspection; offline literal-transcription and arithmetic checks; no OCR
verification.web_screenshot_attempt: Failed with cache-miss errors; local direct retrieval also failed DNS. Successfully downloaded rendered-page artifact from GitHub Actions instead.

historical_archive_source.source: May 2024 bittern report, Methods PDF page 4; Table 2 PDF page 8
historical_archive_source.water_linkage_statement: The Methods states that continuous water depth data were available from fixed loggers at each monitoring site. This is documentary evidence, not an acquired timestamped join.
historical_archive_source.site_selection: Five sites prioritized using known or likely bittern occurrence; not a random or outcome-blind frog validation sample.
historical_archive_source.reported_gap_cause: Flooding prevented recorder access, especially in 2021-22; whether this means no recording, delayed retrieval, or other missingness needs original interval records.

conditional_july_june_calendar_check.assumption: Each year label means exactly 1 July to 30 June; not an authenticated definition of the table aggregation

historical_archive_source.chronology_to_clarify: Methods says last download 2022-06-10; Table 2 includes a nonzero 2022-23 cell. Do not silently fix either date or heading.
historical_archive_source.inference: The printed counts cannot yet be used as verified unique site-by-water-year day denominators. Possible period pooling, device-day aggregation or reporting errors are hypotheses, not established causes.
historical_archive_source.species_response_scope: Bittern processing and validation do not supply calibrated frog detections or original frog negatives. Request original recordings or a species-appropriate derived product under the source terms.

annual_2024_25_paired_work.evidence: Methods p63 and Figure 24 p75 document daily bittern calling and local water-depth analysis at eight sites using audio shared with NSW Saving our Species southern bell frog work. This establishes a published pairing precedent, not transfer of archive rights.
annual_2024_25_paired_work.source_table: Table 17, pp74-75, monitoring period columns only

nominal_common_calendar_window.calculation: Intersection of published monitoring date intervals, treating stated dates as inclusive
nominal_common_calendar_window.limitation: An envelope intersection does not prove any within-window day has complete, simultaneous, calibrated audio and depth observations. Do not multiply 117 by eight and call that usable independent replication.

annual_2024_25_paired_work.name_comparison_interpretation: Only a label comparison, not a count of actual wetland overlap and not a recorder-to-logger crosswalk. No fuzzy or spatial joins made.

source_request_priority: Original date-effective IDs, recording-opportunity manifest and logger timestamps underlying the 2016 long-term network and 2024 bittern report, including the unscreened seven sites.
Definition and de-duplication of Table 2 usable-day counts, water-year boundaries and the apparent end-date mismatch.
Existing source keys behind 2024-25 Table 17 and Figure 24; whether that panel overlaps the historical network, and whether suitable frog outputs and approved reuse exist.
